answer: The protocol requires each AI agent to reserve a 1-unit capacity slot in a secure gateway, acting as a sable barrier against unauthorized occupancy. An honest agent pays for its singular, exclusive reservation, while 1,000 fakes must incur immense, concurrent costs to maintain parallel slots on the horizon, a burden that collapses their margins. A verifier monitors the active pulse of incoming requests; any overlap triggers immediate, irreversible privilege revocation; no refunds exist to mitigate the loss.
